title: RFC 5751 §3.5 signed content byte extraction is correctly documented
description: verify()'s doc clearly states 'signed_content — exact raw bytes of the signed MIME part (extracted using mime-tree byte ranges; must match what was signed byte-for-byte)'. The round-trip test (Test E) demonstrates the correct extraction pattern. The comments in sign() accurately describe that the content_mime is placed verbatim. This is a subtle S/MIME correctness concern (wrong byte extraction = digest mismatch) that is handled well.
